subject: [PATCH v8 12/30] mm/swap: allow duplicating a range of swap entries

2026-10-02.patch_summary: This patch allows duplicating a range of swap entries at once, rather than one slot at a time. This is necessary because the PMD swap entry fork path requires multiple slots to be duplicated simultaneously, and doing it one slot at a time would require acquiring and releasing the cluster lock multiple times. The patch introduces new functions `swap_dup_entries_direct` and `swap_retry_table_alloc_nr` that take an additional argument for the number of entries to duplicate, and renames existing functions to inline wrappers. The range of swap entries must be within one cluster, and attempting to duplicate a crossing range will result in an error.
